name: Cell
description: Represents a table cell. The Cell object is a member of the CellRange collection. The CellRange collection represents all the cells in the specified column or row. To use the CellRange collection, use the Cells keyword.
remarks: You cannot programmatically add cells to or delete cells from a PowerPoint table. Use the Add method of the Columns or Rows collections to add a column or row to a table. Use the Delete method of the Columns or Rows collections to delete a column or row from a table.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Shape
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents a shape in a table cell. Read-only.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents the borders and diagonal lines for the specified Cell object or CellRange collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Selected
properties.description: Returns True if the specified table cell is selected. Read-only.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges one table cell with another. The result is a single table cell.

parameters.name: MergeTo
parameters.description: The Cell object to be merged with.

methods.name: Split
methods.signature: Split(NumRows As Long, NumColumns As Long)
methods.description: Splits a single table cell into multiple cells.

parameters.name: NumRows
parameters.description: Number of rows that the cell is being split into.

parameters.name: NumColumns
parameters.description: Number of columns that the cell is being split into.
